faq.a: Saturday 3 October 2026 at Riverside East, 5 Thornton Street, London E20 2AD. Doors open at 11:40.
Doors 11:40. Women's 2v2 from 12:00. Men's 2v2 from 13:00 to 18:30. The legends game is at 19:00. The afterparty runs from 20:00 to 22:30.

faq.q: How do I get tickets or enter a team?
faq.a: Both are on Eventbrite. Use the Get tickets button on this site.

faq.q: How old do I need to be?
faq.a: 13+ for the day. The afterparty from 8pm is 18+, so under-18s leave at 8pm.
Street football means street shoes. Games are on concrete.

faq.q: Can we bring our own kit?
faq.a: Yes. Build your team's kit and bring it. Reach out to Donis if you want help.

faq.q: Where can I follow the scores?
faq.a: Live on the Games page: donis.shotclubhouse.com/london-26/games. It updates by itself through the day.
The winning men's 2v2 team wins two tickets to Race Across the Desert.
Buy a Donis London 26 Fan Ticket and you're entered into the draw for a signed Paolo Di Canio West Ham shirt. The winner is drawn after the legends game.
No free parking. The nearest car park is Westfield Stratford City, Montfichet Road, E20 1EJ.
Refunds follow the Eventbrite listing's policy.

sponsors.name: Favela Cerveja
blurb: Favela is a premium beer built to capture the taste of Rio. It was started by father and son Charles and Fred Gay.
The range is a crisp 5% lager and Ipanema, a light 5% IPA with citrus notes. Both are vegan and gluten-free.
A share of every sale goes to The Favela Foundation, which funds grassroots education and community projects in Brazil's favelas.

sponsors.name: Flair Digital Agency
blurb: Flair is a founder-focused digital agency for growing businesses in London, Berkshire and across the UK, set up in October 2024.
It covers brand design, paid search and social campaigns, social media management, personal brands for founders, and SEO.
It also sponsors football from England Beach Soccer and Reading FC to grassroots clubs in Berkshire.

sponsors.name: SHOT Clubhouse
blurb: SHOT Clubhouse brings a whole club into one app: teams, fixtures, announcements and the people in it.
For Donis it runs this site, the live scores and tables you follow on your phone, and the big screen at the cage.
